onePageSummary: ‘Fractions’ is developed as a mathematical investigation rather than a list of rules. The chapter connects part-whole relationships, unit fractions, equivalent fractions, comparison, fraction of a quantity. Learners are expected to represent quantities or relationships, choose a strategy, calculate carefully, check the result and explain the reasoning.
